transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I've been experiencing this overflowing energy and feeling incredibly hyperactive for the past seven months. My mood has also been all over the place, shifting from extremely happy to really irritated and angry over minor things. It's gotten to the point where I just can't seem to slow down, and I need help managing these intense mood swings.
Have you ever had hallucinations or strongly held beliefs that others said weren’t true, and if so, did they happen only during these high-energy mood episodes or also when your mood seemed normal?

Yes, I've had times where I saw and heard things that weren't actually there, and believed things that others told me weren't true. However, those experiences only happened during those seven months when my energy was super high and my mood was elevated. They never occurred when my mood was normal or when I was feeling down.
During those high-energy periods, did your symptoms ever become severe enough that you needed to be hospitalized or caused major problems at work, school, finances, or relationships?
To be honest, I'm not really sure. I haven't thought much about whether those episodes caused major disruptions in my work or relationships, or if they were severe enough to warrant a hospital stay.

During those seven months, did you do things like spend much more money than usual, get into serious conflicts, lose a job, or have other people become worried enough to suggest emergency care or hospitalization?
I'm really not sure about those specific situations. I haven't really thought about whether I spent too much money, had job issues, or if anyone suggested I needed emergency care.
When you were seeing or hearing things that weren’t there, were you also feeling unusually energized, sleeping much less, talking fast, or feeling especially euphoric or irritable at the same time?

Yes, definitely. I only saw and heard those things during the times when I was feeling incredibly energized, euphoric, or highly irritable. Those experiences always went hand-in-hand with my high-energy episodes.
During those high-energy periods, how much were you actually sleeping, and did you still feel rested even with much less sleep than usual?
To be honest, I'm not really sure how many hours of sleep I was getting back then. I don't recall what my sleep patterns were like or if I felt rested during those high-energy periods.
Did the seeing or hearing things and unusual beliefs themselves make it hard for you to function or lead anyone to think you needed urgent treatment or hospitalization?
I'm really not sure about that. I haven't thought much about whether those specific experiences on their own caused me functional problems or if they were the reason anyone mentioned hospitalization.

During those high-energy periods, did you notice things like talking much faster than usual, your thoughts racing, feeling unusually confident or powerful, or doing risky things you normally wouldn’t do?

I definitely felt an overwhelming sense of confidence and power back then, almost like I had special abilities. However, I'm not really sure if my thoughts were racing or if I was talking faster than usual. I also didn't really notice if I was doing risky things.
When you felt like you had special abilities, did you believe that so strongly that others said it was unrealistic or not true?

Yes, I was completely convinced that I had special powers and abilities at the time. People around me kept telling me it wasn't real and that I was being unrealistic, but to me, it felt absolutely true.
Did you have one continuous seven-month period of elevated or irritable mood, or were there separate episodes with times in between when your mood returned closer to normal?
It was one continuous seven-month period where my mood and energy stayed constantly high and irritable. There weren't any breaks or times in between where my mood returned to normal.
